config_yaml:
# Single source of truth for every parameter used by the robot, the
# localisation stack, the vision pipeline, the planner and the simulator.
# Units: centimetres, seconds, radians (unless the key name says otherwise).

robot:
  wheels: small                 # which entry of wheel_profiles is mounted
  wheel_profiles:
    small: {degrees_per_cm: 20.73, velocity_cm_s: 9.17}
    large: {degrees_per_cm: 16.39, velocity_cm_s: 11.9}
  wheel_base_cm: 15.25          # distance between the wheel contact points
  radius_cm: 7.5                # footprint radius (collision checks, bumpers)
  drive_dps: 200                # wheel speed used for timed straight/turn motions
  motor_power_limit: 70         # BrickPi power limit (%) for timed motions
  # Empirical corrections for the real motors (BrickPi backend only):
  turn_offset_s: 0.0725         # motor spin-up time added to every turn
  forward_factor: 0.97          # straight runs overshoot by ~3% after stopping

ports:
  # If the robot turns the wrong way on hardware, swap left/right motor here.
  left_motor: A
  right_motor: C
  sonar: 4
  left_touch: 1
  right_touch: 2

sonar:
  offset_cm: 7.0                # sensor face is this far ahead of the robot centre
  sigma_cm: 1.5                 # measured noise at 20-100 cm (sonar calibration)
  min_valid_cm: 20              # readings outside [min, max] are not trusted
  max_valid_cm: 140
  robust_constant: 0.001        # floor added to the likelihood (garbage readings)
  max_raw_cm: 255               # value the NXT sonar reports when it sees nothing

mcl:
  num_particles: 100
  # V0: the original coursework motion model (standard deviations per 10 cm move,
  # and a fixed standard deviation per turn regardless of the angle).
  coursework_model: {sigma_e: 0.3, sigma_f: 0.01, sigma_g: 0.02}
  # V1: Probabilistic Robotics odometry model (Thrun et al. 2005, Table 5.6).
  #   a1: rotation noise from rotation    [rad^2 / rad^2]
  #   a2: rotation noise from translation [rad^2 / cm^2]
  #   a3: translation noise from translation [cm^2 / cm^2]
  #   a4: translation noise from rotation [cm^2 / rad^2]
  # Fitted so that a 10 cm move / 90 deg turn matches the coursework sigmas.
  odometry_alphas: {a1: 0.00016, a2: 0.000001, a3: 0.0009, a4: 0.01}
  ess_threshold: 0.5            # V2: resample only if N_eff < threshold * N
  augmented:                    # V3: augmented MCL random-particle injection
    alpha_slow: 0.01            # long-term likelihood average rate
    alpha_fast: 0.1             # short-term likelihood average rate
    # Inject with p = max(0, 1 - w_fast / (ratio_threshold * w_slow)).
    # 1.0 is the textbook rule; lower values ignore the normal step-to-step
    # fluctuation of a single sonar beam's likelihood.
    ratio_threshold: 0.5
  cluster_radius_cm: 25.0       # pose estimate = weighted mean of particles near the weighted median
  kld:                          # V4: KLD-sampling (Fox 2003)
    epsilon: 0.05
    z_quantile: 2.326           # upper 1 - delta quantile, delta = 0.01
    bin_xy_cm: 5.0
    bin_theta_deg: 15.0
    n_min: 50
    n_max: 1000

behaviours:
  square_side_cm: 40
  bumper_reverse_cm: 10
  bumper_step_cm: 10
  wall_follow_target_cm: 30
  wall_follow_kp: 10            # dps per cm of distance error
  wall_follow_window: 5         # moving-average length (readings)
  wall_follow_period_s: 0.5

navigation:
  start: [84, 30, 0.0]
  waypoints: [[180, 30], [180, 54], [138, 54], [138, 168], [114, 168], [114, 84], [84, 84], [84, 30]]
  dist_tol_cm: 3.0
  ang_tol_rad: 0.2
  max_step_cm: 20.0
  settle_s: 0.5                 # pause before reading the sonar
  sweep_steps: 12               # relocalisation sweep: turn 360 deg in this many steps

camera:
  width: 640
  height: 480
  # Ground-plane correspondences: [x_cm, y_cm, u_px, v_px] (robot frame, x forward, y left)
  homography_points:
    - [80, 20, 152, 65]
    - [80, -20, 530, 76]
    - [20, 10, 122, 336]
    - [20, -10, 550, 346]
  red_hsv_ranges:               # red wraps around hue 0 so it needs two ranges
    - [[0, 50, 50], [10, 255, 255]]
    - [[170, 50, 50], [180, 255, 255]]
  min_blob_area_px: 150

dwa:
  max_dps: 600
  motor_power_limit: 85
  max_accel_cm_s2: 60
  obstacle_radius_cm: 3.0
  safe_dist_cm: 15.0
  tau_s: 2.0                    # look-ahead horizon
  dt_s: 0.1                     # control period
  v_samples: 13                 # per wheel -> 169 candidate pairs
  sim_steps: 6
  weights: {forward: 2.0, obstacle: 2.0, reverse: 0.3, stagnation: 0.05}
  stagnation_speed_cm_s: 10.0
  goal_cm: [350, 0]
  finish_x_cm: 300
  min_obstacle_cm: 10
  max_obstacle_cm: 150

simulation:
  # "True" noise of the simulated robot, set from the practical 1 calibration
  # (0.3 cm and 0.01 rad per 10 cm driven, 0.02 rad per 90 deg turn) plus a
  # small constant per turn that no filter models. The filters never read
  # these values; they use their own motion models above.
  trans_std_per_cm: 0.03
  drift_std_per_cm: 0.001        # heading drift while driving straight
  rot_std_per_rad: 0.0127
  rot_std_const: 0.002
  sonar_outlier_prob: 0.03
  sonar_max_incidence_deg: 40    # beyond this the echo is usually lost
  sonar_lost_prob: 0.7
  camera_fov_deg: 50
  can_height_cm: 11.0
